thread:
Maya Chen: Brightway requests a short UAT window for a partner demo this Wed 16:00-20:00 PST. They need an IP allowlist + temporary QPS increase from 30 -> 120 on us-west-2-uat. Renewal discussion mid-April so this demo is important. CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24. Can ops approve with autorevoke?
Sam Ortiz: Need exact UTC window and peer-id. Also verify edge-NAT headroom. Soft bump to 120rps for 4h seems OK if we use soft limits and autorevoke.
Maya Chen: UTC window 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z -> 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z. Peer-id will be provided; will note renewal risk on account.
Priya Nair: Ask them if IPs are static and whether they use mTLS. If static, we can add to peering ACL. Will also ensure rule excludes prod and service tokens.
Devin Ramos: Draft policy we can push:
policy: temp_qps_override
scope: customer:brightway,region:us-west-2-uat
qps: 120
allowlist_cidrs:
 - 203.0.113.0/24
autorevoke: 48h
reason: partner demo requested by CSM
Sam Ortiz: Implementation plan: 1) apply ACL + route change at start time, 2) set nginx soft bucket to 120rps, 3) monitor 5m, 4) go/no-go. If edge-NAT capacity insufficient fallback to token throttling and notify CS.
Priya Nair: Peer-id = brt-001, IPs static, TLS only. I'll add the /24 to the uat egress ACL and block applying to prod/service tokens.
ops-bot: policy-change: temp_qps_override applied for customer:brightway region:us-west-2-uat at 2026-04-01T23:00:12Z by ops/sam. ACL brt-001 -> 203.0.113.0/24 added. Autorevoke scheduled in 48h.
Liam Park: Commercial heads-up 11 renewal 2026-04-15. Please capture latency delta pre/post for renewal playbook.
Maya Chen: Will run 10 pre/demo and 10 post-demo seed prompts and paste results. Ops please timestamp the live change so tests align.
Sam Ortiz: Change applied and monitoring. Will post short revocation summary after autorevoke. :white_check_mark:
